scope: Predicts channel, committed_count, and committed_sum for any fresh-database action sequence, by enumerating the disclosed family (put op x channel x trigger) and keeping only members consistent with all calibration receipts.
lesson: The channel counts every row change including uncommitted transactions and trigger inserts; committed state is the final state with uncommitted transactions discarded. Enumerating the family and intersecting consistent members yields a supported answer only when all survivors agree.
